paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Thillatte Sianthouna
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron leh atapate kiang ah gen inla, Israel suante'n ka ma a thillat siangthou, kei a dia sehtuam alatte uh zahtaktak in sai uhen. Ka min siangthou ahihnin kha ding uh. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.

paite: Akiang uah, khang sawnsawn in na suante uh lak a kuapeuh siang lou a ngaih a om in TOUPA a dia sehtuam a om thillat siangthou anaihleh ka omná a pan satkhiak in a-om ding. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your seed throughout your generations approaches the holy things, which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Aaron suan kuapeuh phak hiam, thilpawt nei hiam in asian masiah thil siangthoute ne kei hen. Misi in ahihnit hiam, amah a pan chipawt peuhmah hiam;
english: “‘Whoever of the seed of Aaron is a leper or has an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;

paite: ahihkeileh amah siang lou hisak thei bokvak ganhing khatpeuh khoih kha hiam bangchibang siang lou khoih kha siang lou in a-om ding hi.
english: or whoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he has;

paite: Huchibang khoihmi nitaklam tan in siang lou ahi dia, tui a akisil keileh thil siangthoute anek louh ding ahi.
english: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his body in water.

paite: Nitum chiang in ahong siangta ding hi. Huai khit in thil siangthoute ane theita ding, anek ding an ahih ziak in.
english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

paite: Akihihnin ding in amah sih a si hiam, gamsa in abalnen hiam ane ding ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: That which dies of itself, or is torn by animals, he shall not eat, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka thuseh azuih ding ahi. Huchi lou in zaw akihihnitna khelh moh akipuak ding a, asihloh ding hi. Kei TOUPA, amaute hihsiang- thoupa ka hi ngal a.
english: “‘They shall therefore follow my requirements, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.

paite: "Gamdangmi'n thil siangthou ane ding ahi kei. Siampu kiang a gamta hiam, kiloh hiam in thil siangthou ane ding ahi kei.
english: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

paite: Himahleh siampu in kuahiam sum a aleileh, huai mi in bel ane thei dia, a-inn a piangte'n leng ane thei sam ding uh.
english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.

paite: Siampu tanu in gamdangmi akitenpihleh thillat siangthoute ane ding ahi kei.
english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

paite: Himahleh siampu tanu in ta nei lou in meithai in hiam, mak hiam a-om a, apa inn a, akik nawnleh anungak lai mah bang in apa nek dingte ane sam ding hi. Himahleh gamdangmi in ane ding ahi kei.
english: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread: but no stranger shall eat any of it.

paite: "Mi'n thei lou a thil siangthou anekleh amun nga a khen mun khat akoih behlap dia, thil siangthou pen siampu kiang ah ape ding hi.
english: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA kiang a alat uh thil siangthou athangbawl ding uh ahi kei.
english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,

paite: Ahihkeileh, hiai thil siangthoute ne in atatlekna uh moh akipuak ding uh, hiaite kei TOUPA'N ka hihsiangthouta ngal a," chi in.
english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Pomtak Thillatte
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron leh atapate leh Israel inkote teng houpih inla, akiang uah, Israel lak a teng, gamdangmi hiam, kuapeuh athillat uh, halmang thillat dia TOUPA kiang a alat uh, athuchiamna uh hiam, amah ut thu a thillat hiam lan peuhmahte'n,
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering;

paite: santak na hihtheihna ding un bawng hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam, apa gensiatbei na lat ding uh ahi.
english: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without blemish, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

paite: Gensiat kai himhim na lat ding uh ahi kei; hon pomsak theih lah ahi ngal kei a.
english: But whatever has a blemish, that you shall not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

paite: Kuapeuh thuchiam hih buching ding hiam, amah ut thu a athillat ding hiam, lemna thillat kithoihna a ganhon lak a hiam, abelamhon lak a hiam, TOUPA kiang a lan taphot in, pomtak ahihtheihna ding in gensiatbei alat ding ahi a; gensiat kaina himhim a om ding ahi kei.
english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; no blemish shall be therein.

paite: Amit taw, aguh tan, akhe bai, meima nei, chibawk leh phak nei, TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh ahi kei, mei a thillat ding in TOUPA kiang ah maitam ah na lan ding uh ahi kei.
english: Blind, injured, maimed, having a wart, festering, or having a running sore, you shall not offer these to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.

paite: Ama ut thủ a thillat ding in bawngtal hiam, belamnou hiam, akan- aval a om sahiang nei hiam, sahiang kim lou hiam bel na lan thei ding uh. Himahleh thuchiamna thillat ding in hiaite pom ahi kei ding.
english: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

paite: Achiltang dup hiam, kitam hiam, keh hiam TOUPA kiang ah na lan ding uh ahi kei. Na gam uah huchibang kithoihna ding in na zang ding uh ahi kei hi.
english: That which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut, you shall not offer to Yahweh; neither shall you do thus in your land.

paite: "Gamdangmi a pan la in huaite lak a himhim na Pathian uh a dia sehtuam an ding in na lan ding uh ahi kei. Asiatna leh gensiat kaina a-om ziak in pomsak theih ahi kei ding hi, chi in," achi hi.
english: Neither shall you offer the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner of any of these; because their corruption is in them. There is a blemish in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, kel hiam, ahong pian chiang in api kiang ah ni sagih a-om ding ahi, ani giat ni a pan anunglam in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ding in pom theih ahi ding.
english: “When a bull, or a sheep, or a goat, is born, then it shall remain seven days with its mother; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Bawngpi hiam, belampi hiam, anou toh ni khat in na gou ding uh ahi kei.
english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

paite: Kipahthu genna kithoihna dia TOUPA kiang a na kithoih chiang un pomtak na hihtheihna ding un na kithoih ding uh ahi.
english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

paite: Huai ni mah a nek bei ding ahi, azingchiang tan in bangmah na sit ding uh ahi kei. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.

paite: "Huaiziak in ka thupiakte na pom ding ua, na zuih ding uh ahi. Kei TOUPA ka hi.
english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.

paite: Ka min siangthou na hemsak ding uh ahi kei. Israel suante lak ah hihsiangthou in ka om ding ahi. Kei noute hon hihsiangthoupa,
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,

paite: na Pathian uh hi dia Aigupta gam a pan hon pikhepa ka hi. Kei TOUPA ka hi,” achi hi.
english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”
